g.text: Pumping an unconfined aquifer lowers the water table and saturated thickness near the well
Qualitative water-table cone, not a numerical Dupuit solution. h is saturated thickness above an impermeable base. The displayed steady well equation
assumes radial Dupuit flow and negligible recharge between the observation radii; the recharge arrows describe the broader conceptual aquifer, not an
added term in that equation. Dewatering changes transmissivity.
